_README: Negotiated rates that hospitals publish under the federal hospital price transparency rule (45 CFR 180.50). These are prices the hospitals themselves posted, not federal figures and not estimates. Per code and billing class: the lowest, median and highest distinct negotiated dollar amount among commercial plans, outpatient setting, no modifier; percentage-of-charge, per-diem, "other" and algorithm-only rates are counted in notInSpread, never converted. No average is taken across plans. Built by scripts/payer/build_private_rates.py from files listed in sources.

Fee schedule rate ($169.17).    This procedure will have the diagnostic imaging rule applied to it.  When the diagnostic imaging rule is applied, diagnostic imaging procedures are grouped based on their Diagnostic Imaging Family Indicator (typically based on the value from the Medicare Physician Fee Schedule). This procedure's family indicator is 88. Then within each group, procedures are paid by splitting them into their Professional Component (PC) and Technical Component (TC). To rank the procedures, it splits the technical and professional components and calculates the allowed amounts for each procedure. To evaluate the technical component, the allowed amount is calculated as if the charge had a TC modifier. For the Professional Component it does the same with a 26 modifier. It then ranks the procedures by the sum of the resulting technical and professional components. The highest priced procedure is reimbursed at 100%, for both components. Subsequent procedures within the family have a defined PC percentage applied to their PC part, and a defined TC percentage applied to their TC part.  The PC% is 100% and the TC% is 50%.
